item.title: Robert’s Rules of Order turns 150 years old
item.description: DULUTH, Minn. — One of the most influential rule books for public meetings operate turned 150 years old Thursday. Robert’s Rules of Order was written in 1876 and is still shaping modern meetings today. item.title: Mayor Roger Reinert speaks on skywalk system
item.description: DULUTH, Minn. — Following the release of a study regarding the skywalk system, the City of Duluth Mayor, Roger Reinert, weighed in.
